name: RoboReward
description: RoboReward is a robotics reward dataset and benchmark built on large-scale real-robot corpora, designed to evaluate vision-language reward models for robotics tasks. It includes counterfactual relabeling to generate negative and near-miss examples, enabling systematic evaluation of reward models across diverse tasks and embodiments.
reputation: A new robotics benchmark with promising design for reward-model evaluation, but it is still early-stage and not yet widely adopted.
notes: Includes counterfactual relabeling to create negative and near-miss examples; enables evaluation of vision-language reward models on real robot tasks.
